summary.text: HOMLAGARDEN AS is a private limited company registered in Norheimsund, founded 2024-01-25. HOMLAGARDEN AS is registered for poultry farming, organic production, and slaughterhouse operations with processing of meat and poultry products. Its statutory purpose states that the operations should be defensible from an ethical and ecological perspective. It was previously named HOMLAGARDEN INTERIM AS until 2024-05-28. Its main industry code is 10.130: production of meat and poultry meat products. The register shows 72 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 33 290 528 NOK and the annual result was -372 453 NOK; operating income was down from 33 596 229 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 856 312 NOK in 2024 to -372 453 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 1 953 023 NOK in 2024 to 1 871 431 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is homlagarden.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The registered employee count went from 78 on 2025-11-13 to 72 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
